Class WorldBuffer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.dod.WorldBuffer
public class WorldBuffer extends Object
High-performance Data-Oriented Storage for world hexagonal grid. Uses flat primitive arrays (AOSOA pattern) for GPU compatibility.
